name: lyra-downloads-integration
description: Lyra Downloads Integration — extensão do Firefox para enviar downloads ao Lyra Downloads

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.json && cp -r static/. dist/
scripts.lint: npm run build && web-ext lint --source-dir dist --self-hosted
scripts.package: npm run build && web-ext build --source-dir dist --artifacts-dir artifacts --overwrite-dest
